_comment: HK45 Tactical preset for cgs-mold (gun-dip method). Frame: draw axis = Y (rear/grip = +Y), up = Z. Cut points auto-detected then tuned visually per scan. SOURCE OF TRUTH = ../METHOD-NOTES.md.

solidify._note: voxel-fill the MOLD into one manifold solid before cutting; precondition for a clean boolean

grip_cut._note: diagonal cube DIFFERENCE: first point = trigger-guard/grip corner, 20mm below; second point = beavertail, 10mm below. Verified clean (manifold 0/0) 2026-06-29.

smooth._note: VALIDATED 2026-06-30. 4-stage feature-preserving: flat denoise -> crease de-zigzag -> roughness deburr -> re-straighten. Smooth AND sharp.

offset._note: VALIDATED 2026-06-30. Region = barrel+slide+beavertail ONLY (Z>z_line), NOT global. Owner-confirmed z_line=14 keeps the grip/frame/trigger-guard unaffected. Feathered 2mm at the parting line.

split._note: VALIDATED 2026-06-30. Clean clamshell split (bisect+holes_fill, ZERO material loss), NOT a saw cut. Seam = vertical plane through the BARREL BORE AXIS (circle-fit of the muzzle crown, _bore_center_x), NOT the mold symmetry plane (controls pull it off the bore). plane_x=null -> auto bore-fit; set a number to override. HK45 bore axis X = -0.777.
